name: bb-plugin-project-space

bb.name: Project Space
bb.description: A full-screen documentation space per project: Markdown pages, browser-rendered HTML, and tldraw canvases that agents and you edit together, stored in .bb-space/.

themes.name: Blue Topaz
themes.description: After the Obsidian Blue Topaz theme: headings colored by level, green italic, orange inline code, quotes behind an accent bar, in chat and in the space.

themes.name: Things
themes.description: After the Obsidian Things theme: headings colored by level, tinted bold, italic and quotes, in chat and in the space.
